title: Astronomers confirmed the youngest known planet — and it is still being born
freshness: Published September 16, 2026 — within the preferred 15-day freshness window.
excerpt: Astronomers have confirmed Elias 2-24 b, a Jupiter-mass world less than a million years old — the youngest known planet. It is still growing inside the disk of gas and dust around its young star, letting us see planet formation while it is actually happening.
whyItMatters: The previous youngest known planets were already more than five million years old, and existing models struggled to explain how giant planets could form even that quickly. Elias 2-24 b shows that Jupiter-like worlds can assemble much earlier than expected, meaning an important part of our planet-formation story is still missing.
